name: fund-capital-deployment-diagram
sourceText: Fund flows follow Atlas Fund during this round in an illustrative example. Ada contributes 60 USD to Atlas Fund. Bo contributes 40 USD to Atlas Fund. Atlas Fund deploys 70 USD to Shop. Atlas Fund deploys 30 USD to Maker. The stated transfers retain their direction and identity during this round. Capital reaches investments. Money follows the stated paths.

name: fund-proceeds-distribution-diagram
sourceText: Fund flows follow Atlas Fund during this round in an illustrative example. Shop pays 60 USD to Atlas Fund. Maker pays 40 USD to Atlas Fund. Atlas Fund distributes 70 USD to Ada. Atlas Fund distributes 30 USD to Bo. The stated transfers retain their direction and identity during this round. Proceeds reach investors. Money follows the stated paths.

name: ownership-share-issue-diagram
sourceText: An illustrative dilution example follows ExampleCo. Ada owns 40 of 100 shares in ExampleCo. Ada owns 40 percent of ExampleCo. ExampleCo issues 100 new shares. Ada keeps 40 of 200 shares in ExampleCo. Ada now owns 20 percent of ExampleCo. Value is not stated. Share count stays the same. Percentage and value are different.

name: portfolio-shared-holdings-diagram
sourceText: An illustrative portfolio exposure example follows Fund A and Fund B. Fund A holds ExampleCo. Fund B owns ExampleCo. ExampleCo is shared by both funds in this example. Other exposure is not stated and the fund names remain distinct. Shared exposure remains visible despite the different fund names.

name: portfolio-shared-driver-diagram
sourceText: An illustrative portfolio exposure example follows Fund A and Fund B. Fund A is exposed to interest rates. Fund B depends on interest rates. interest rates is shared by both funds in this example. Other exposure is not stated and the fund names remain distinct. Shared exposure remains visible despite the different fund names.
